title: Sharp weighted weak-type bounds for commutators of singular integrals
summary: We establish sharp weak-type bounds for commutators of Calderón--Zygmund operators and $\text{BMO}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ symbols with respect to $A_p$ weights. We prove that the bound \looseness=-1 $$ \|[b,T]\|_{L^p(w)\rightarrow L^{p,\infty}(w)}\lesssim [w]_{A_p}^{\max(2,p')} $$ for $p \in (1,\infty)$ and $w \in A_p$ is sharp for general $T \in \text{CZO}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and $b \in \text{BMO}(\mathbb{R}^n)$.
